entries.title: A Place to Land
entries.scriptureText: The Lord is my shepherd; I have all that I need. He lets me rest in green meadows; he leads me beside peaceful streams. He renews my strength. He guides me along right paths, bringing honor to his name.
entries.body:
David didn't write this psalm from a palace. He wrote it from memory — the memory of what it felt like to be small, exposed, and dependent on something bigger than himself. The image of a shepherd wasn't a metaphor for comfort alone. It was a metaphor for trust earned over time.

What does it look like for you to trust that there's enough — enough grace, enough direction, enough strength — for today?
entries.author: Landon Parker
